title: Camera subscriber
description: Use the same subscription pattern as the LiDAR lesson with a different sensor and Image message. Print each image width and height.
steps: Inspect /camera/image_raw with ros2 topic info.
Subscribe to Image and print msg.width and msg.height in the callback.
Run the node and check the repeated output.
hints: A camera is another publisher. Use ros2 topic list and ros2 topic info /camera/image_raw.
Create an Image subscription with self.image_callback and queue depth 10.
self.subscription = self.create_subscription(Image, "/camera/image_raw", self.image_callback, 10)
Inside the callback: print(f"Image: {msg.width} x {msg.height}")

content.title: Camera subscriber
content.description: Use the same subscription pattern as the LiDAR lesson with a different sensor and Image message. Print each image width and height.
steps: Inspect /camera/image_raw with ros2 topic info.
Subscribe to Image and print msg->width and msg->height in the callback.
Run the node and check the repeated output.
hints: Inspect /camera/image_raw with ros2 topic info to confirm its type.
Use create_subscription<sensor_msgs::msg::Image> and retain its SharedPtr in the node.
In the callback, read msg->width and msg->height into unsigned integers, then print them with RCLCPP_INFO.
